domains.title: Deferred closer source custody
optionalFields: hold.json lastRetentionAttemptAt: persisted watcher backoff timestamp for bounded retry in the verified worker checkout
hold.json publishedHead: continued exact source can satisfy teardown without a bundle
source.json redrive: attempt count, live head, next due time and validated candidate
source.json publishedHead and publishedAt: authoritative publication settles bundled to matches-target
domains.semantics: Unsafe or unreadable exact-target custody holds successors. Clean matching-target source with confirmed cleanup resumes paced retry. For pre-upgrade controller timeouts, the watcher can finalize proof from the original launch-bound drain, lease disposition and exact-head checks before continuing. Explicit launches[].custodyRequired retains unsafe fallback; legacy retry entries alone and corrupt retry files do not hold unrelated heads. Teardown retries source bundling and continuation uses bounded lock contention recovery.
